label: Handbook material densities
note: Nominal MASS densities for common construction materials. This is a way to fill a density basis quickly, not a basis in itself: nothing here knows what the material names in your model mean, and nobody has approved these numbers for your project. Whoever signs the deliverable owns every value they apply. Do not read a Eurocode weight density straight off a table into this field: EN 1991-1-1 quotes kN/m3, and 24.0 kN/m3 is 2447 kg/m3, not 2400.
